records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.measurement_compare_dialog.MeasurementComparePanel.apply_workspace_state#1
records.source: Recognized, correctly typed entries are applied independently. Unknown fixed choices are ignored; measurement and class identifiers that are not yet offered remain pending until an ordinary refresh or data update. Selected guide and well identifiers are retained without reading files. An active join owned by this panel is cancelled so its late result cannot replace the restored state. No new join, file read or inference starts. The cached comparison and figure remain unchanged until the next refresh.
records.context: Recognized, correctly typed entries are applied independently. Unknown fixed choices are ignored; measurement and class identifiers that are not yet offered remain pending until an ordinary refresh or data update. Selected guide and microplate sample position identifiers are retained without reading files. An active join owned by this panel is cancelled so its late result cannot replace the restored state. No new join, file read or inference starts. The cached comparison and figure remain unchanged until the next refresh.
records.translation: Igenkända poster med rätt typ tillämpas oberoende av varandra. Okända fasta val ignoreras; identifierare för mätningar och klasser som ännu inte erbjuds förblir väntande tills en vanlig uppdatering eller datauppdatering sker. Valda guide- och brunnsidentifierare behålls utan att läsa filer. En aktiv sammanfogning som ägs av denna panel avbryts så att dess sena resultat inte kan ersätta det återställda tillståndet. Ingen ny sammanfogning, filläsning eller inferens startas. Den cachade jämförelsen och figuren förblir oförändrade tills nästa uppdatering.

records.source: Recognized state cancels the pending montage and queued coefficient loads. Control signals are blocked while settings are restored, so an existing montage does not automatically reload or redraw. Crop choices are applied for the next explicit build; its existing well tabs retain their own captions and images.
records.context: Recognized state cancels the pending montage and queued coefficient loads. Control signals are blocked while settings are restored, so an existing montage does not automatically reload or redraw. Extracted image region choices are applied for the next explicit build; its existing well tabs retain their own captions and images.
records.translation: Igenkänt tillstånd avbryter den väntande montageinläsningen och köade koefficientinläsningar. Bildutsnittsvalen tillämpas vid nästa uttryckligen begärda bygge; befintliga brunnsflikar behåller sina egna bildtexter och bilder.
